User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application.

uid.description: Unique identifier for the user, from Firebase Auth.

role.description: Role of the user (e.g., admin, user).

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the user account was created.

Product.title: Product
Product.description: Represents a product in the shop.

Order.title: Order
Order.description: Represents an order placed by a user.

subTotal.description: Subtotal amount of the order (items only).

shippingFee.description: Shipping fee set by the admin.

totalAmount.description: Total amount of the order (subtotal + service charge + shipping).

shippingAddress.description: The shipping address for this specific order.

CartItem.title: CartItem
CartItem.description: Represents an item in the shopping cart.

id.description: Unique identifier for the cart item.

quantity.description: Quantity of the product in the cart.

price.description: Price of the product at time of adding to cart.

startDate.description: Starting date for displaying the flyer.

endDate.description: Ending date for displaying the flyer.

ServiceChecklistItem.title: ServiceChecklistItem
ServiceChecklistItem.description: Represents a checklist item for additional services in custom orders.

id.description: Unique identifier for the service checklist item.

description.description: Description of the service checklist item.

expectationField.description: Field for setting expectations for the service.

isCompleted.description: Indicates whether the checklist item is completed.

Notification.title: Notification
Notification.description: Represents a notification for a user.

userId.description: The ID of the user this notification is for.

link.description: A URL to navigate to when the notification is clicked.

isRead.description: Whether the user has read the notification.

HomePageSettings.title: HomePageSettings
HomePageSettings.description: Configuration for the application's home page.

id.description: Unique identifier for the settings document (e.g., 'home_page').

heroTitle.description: The main headline for the hero section.

heroSubtitle.description: The subtitle or supporting text for the hero section.

heroImageUrl.description: URL for the hero background image.

featuredProductIds.description: An array of Product IDs to feature on the home page.

FooterSettings.title: FooterSettings
FooterSettings.description: Configuration for the application's main footer.

id.description: Unique identifier for the settings document (e.g., 'footer_settings').

tagline.description: The short tagline displayed in the footer.

aboutUs.description: A short text about the company.

facebookUrl.description: URL for the company's Facebook page.

instagramUrl.description: URL for the company's Instagram page.

youtubeUrl.description: URL for the company's YouTube channel.

productVideoId.description: The ID of a specific YouTube video for the product showcase.

firestore.reasoning: The Firestore security model is based on an 'admin' role. User-specific data (cart items, orders, notifications) is stored under `/users/{userId}` to leverage path-based authorization for the user themselves, while the 'admin' role grants global access. A single `/settings` collection holds sitewide configuration documents like `home_page` and `footer_settings`. This separation simplifies security rules. The admin role is managed via a custom claim on the user's auth token, which is the most secure and efficient method. This design ensures that security rules can be written clearly and efficiently, promoting a more secure and scalable application.
